build_single_object_rendering_task: build a SingleObjRenderingTask to remember and render a single 3D object from multiple views
load_dataset_shapeview: load a ShapeViewDataset for training validation or test splits with configurable view resolution
build_generator_neural_renderer: build a NeuralRenderer generator with configurable beam resolution frames and raymarching steps
train_step_with_pruning: run a training step that supports voxel pruning splitting and online rendering at specified update steps
save_image_validation: save a validation image to disk organized by object name and view index
